title: Τreatment Standards and Outcomes of Patients With ER/PR Positive, HER2-negative Metastatic Breast Cancer
brief_summary: • To capture the treatment patterns and clinical characteristics of patients with ER/PR positive, HER2-negative MBC in Greece
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Women with histological confirmed ER/PR positive, HER2-negative MBC
* Age \>18 years old
* Patients initiating first or second line therapy for ER/PR positive, HER2-negative MBC
* Adequate hematologic, renal and hepatic function
* Signed informed consent (ICF)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Active malignancy other than MBC
* Active infection
study_population: Women with histological confirmed ER/PR positive, HER2-negative MBC
